# eetree-sim 1
# name r2r-dac
# param R 10000
# param VREF 5
# param fclk 100
# let dt = 1/(fclk*64)
# let sp = 8
$ 1 ${dt} ${sp} 50 ${VREF} 50
r 64 136 64 184 0 ${2*R}
g 64 208 64 224 0 0
r 144 136 144 184 0 ${2*R}
r 176 96 224 96 0 ${R}
r 256 136 256 184 0 ${2*R}
r 288 96 336 96 0 ${R}
r 368 136 368 184 0 ${2*R}
r 400 96 448 96 0 ${R}
r 480 136 480 184 0 ${2*R}
R 144 240 144 272 0 2 ${fclk/2} ${VREF/2} ${VREF/2} 0 0.5
R 256 240 256 272 0 2 ${fclk/4} ${VREF/2} ${VREF/2} 0 0.5
R 368 240 368 272 0 2 ${fclk/8} ${VREF/2} ${VREF/2} 0 0.5
R 480 240 480 272 0 2 ${fclk/16} ${VREF/2} ${VREF/2} 0 0.5
207 752 112 784 112 0 OUT
a 576 112 672 112 9 12 -12 1000000 0 0 100000
w 144 96 64 96 0
w 64 96 64 136 0
w 64 184 64 208 0
w 144 96 144 136 0
w 144 184 144 240 0
w 144 96 176 96 0
w 224 96 256 96 0
w 256 96 256 136 0
w 256 184 256 240 0
w 256 96 288 96 0
w 336 96 368 96 0
w 368 96 368 136 0
w 368 184 368 240 0
w 368 96 400 96 0
w 448 96 480 96 0
w 480 96 480 136 0
w 480 184 480 240 0
w 480 96 576 96 0
w 576 128 560 128 0
w 560 128 560 160 0
w 560 160 704 160 0
w 704 160 704 112 0
w 672 112 704 112 0
w 704 112 752 112 0
x 64 56 264 60 0 18 R-2R 梯形 DAC（运放缓冲）
x 64 312 264 316 0 14 B0…B3 由方波驱动（二进制计数，每 ${si(1/fclk)}s 一个码），OUT 为 16 级阶梯
o 13 4 0 4098 ${VREF} 0.01 0 2 12 0
